name: bento-metrics
title: Bento metrics
description: A metrics section in Tiles: big figures that roll in once when the section comes into view, with sparklines and change pills. Final at once under reduced motion.

props.name: intro
props.description: A short line under the heading.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A small mono label above the heading.

props.name: note
props.description: A fine-print line under the grid, such as "Example data." or the source and date of real figures.

props.name: metrics
props.description: The figure tiles, two to six.

props.name: roll
props.description: Roll the figures in when the section first comes into view. Never under reduced motion. Default true.

a11y.text: A section named by its h2 with a list of tiles with an h3 label each. The real value is in screen-reader-only text and the rolling digits are aria-hidden; DeltaPill from chart-kit reads the direction; the sparkline takes the metric label (or trendLabel) as its label.

With roll (default true) the figures show 0 after mount and roll up once when they scroll into view; the server markup has the real values. Under reduced motion they never roll and show the real values.
